task.title: Read and Send Messages
task.shortdesc: Review messages and create a new message for a selected patient or recipient.

step.cmd: Review the available messages and select a message to read it.
Select the option to create a new message.
Select the patient or recipient associated with the message.
Enter the message details and send the message.

taskbody.result: The message is submitted to the selected recipient or patient record according to the system configuration.
